description: This Java source file defines a custom Android View class 'TouchDisplayView' that visualizes multi-touch events and their history. It handles touch input, stores historical position data for each touch pointer, and renders circles representing current and past touch points on the screen.

classes.name: TouchDisplayView
classes.description: Custom Android View for displaying multi-touch points with their history.

classes.name: TouchHistory
classes.description: Data class holding touch point information, including position, pressure, and historical positions; object pooling is used for efficiency.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input events, updating the stored touch pointers and their histories based on user interaction.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders active touch points and their historical positions on the Canvas.

methods.name: initialisePaint
methods.description: Sets up Paint objects for drawing circles, text, and borders with proper scaling.

methods.name: drawCircle
methods.description: Draws circles representing current and historical positions of a touch point, scaled based on pressure.

methods.name: setTouch
methods.description: Updates touch position and pressure data.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Stores previous positions to maintain a history of touch movements.

methods.name: recycle
methods.description: Recycles TouchHistory objects back into the pool for reuse.
